guidance.bestFor: The plain anatomy of title, description, body text and a full width outline button in the footer

whenNotToUse.when: A short help notice whose only action is an inline text link

guidance.bestFor: A header ruled off from the body by a bottom border, with a description line and no footer

whenNotToUse.when: A ruled header that also needs a ruled footer holding a button

guidance.bestFor: Tight zero gap sections: a slim header with its own button, a body ruled above and below, and a footer button
agentNotes: Keep `border-none` on `CardFooter`; nova and lyra draw their own footer top rule, which doubles the bottom border of the body

guidance.bestFor: A titled header and a footer button, each split from the body by a rule, with no description line

whenNotToUse.when: Compact sections with no outer padding and a button inside the header

guidance.bestFor: A help notice whose only action is a link style button with an external link icon

whenNotToUse.when: A titled block with a description line and a full width footer button

guidance.bestFor: A help notice with an overflow menu of team actions in the header and an avatar chip button in the footer
agentNotes: The 3 `DropdownMenuItem` entries and the footer avatar `Button` have no handlers; wire each to your own action

guidance.bestFor: A rounded photo inset above a Trending badge, a Featured tag, a blurb and a Get Started button
agentNotes: The `img` loads a random picsum.photos grayscale shot with alt text 16:9; set your own source and a real description

whenNotToUse.when: A photo running edge to edge with the copy centered below it

name: c-card-8
title: Card with image scale hover effect
label: Image Hover Zoom
description: Card with image scale hover effect

guidance.bestFor: A full bleed photo that zooms on hover under a bottom dark gradient holding a white title and line
agentNotes: `Card` is fixed at `h-96` with the copy pinned to the bottom, so long text runs up and clips at the top; raise the height with it

whenNotToUse.when: A photo tile that also names its author with an avatar, email and badge

guidance.bestFor: An edge to edge photo flush with the top, then a centered badge, blurb and a fit width call to action
agentNotes: Replace the picsum.photos `img` and its 16:9 alt with your own photo and alt text describing it

whenNotToUse.when: A photo inset with rounded corners inside the padding, copy left aligned

name: c-card-10
title: Full card with image and shadow fade effect
label: Image Shadow Fade
description: Full card with image and shadow fade effect

guidance.bestFor: A tall photo with dark fades top and bottom and an author row of verified avatar, email and New badge over it
agentNotes: The `AvatarImage` alt reads James Brown and the fallback JB while the name link says Nick Johnson; make all 3 match
`CustomBadge` is a hardcoded blue verified tick with no text alternative; render it only for verified authors

whenNotToUse.when: A photo tile with only a title and one line over a bottom fade

guidance.bestFor: A stacked deck look from 2 blank layers peeking out below the bottom edge, behind a standard title, body and footer
agentNotes: The `size-fit` wrapper shrinks to the card and holds the 2 depth layers, so widen it too when the card should fill a grid cell
The depth layers hardcode `rounded-lg`, so match their radius to your style when it rounds `Card` differently

whenNotToUse.when: A single flat surface with no layers showing beneath its edge

guidance.bestFor: A sign in form with email, a password field that toggles visibility, a forgot link, a GitHub button and terms
agentNotes: The `form` `onSubmit` only calls `preventDefault`; send the email and password to your sign in endpoint there
Forgot password and Terms of Service keep a placeholder `href`, and the Github `Button` has no handler

guidance.bestFor: Credit used against the plan on a progress bar over 5 cost rows that fade out until a round toggle expands them
agentNotes: Every amount and the `Progress` `value` of 90 are literals in the markup; render them from your billing data
`isOpen` swaps a fixed max height, 192px closed and 500px open, so a longer cost list clips even when expanded
`Card` carries `overflow-visible` so the round toggle can hang past its bottom edge; every style clips a `Card` otherwise

guidance.bestFor: A deployment success message under a glowing terminal icon on a fuchsia fade, then 4 striped label and value rows
agentNotes: Replace the 4 label and value pairs in `stats` with your own deployment fields
The header uses fixed fuchsia classes such as `from-fuchsia-50/80` with no dark variant; retint them to your accent

name: c-card-15
title: Stat card with trend and overflow menu
label: Stat Trend
description: Stat card with trend and overflow menu

guidance.bestFor: A single KPI with label, large figure, a trend badge that flips color and arrow for a drop, last month value and a 5 item menu
agentNotes: Lift `title`, `value`, `delta`, `positive` and `lastMonth` into props; they are constants inside the component
`positive` picks the badge variant and arrow; derive it from the sign of `delta` so the two cannot disagree
None of the 5 `DropdownMenuItem` actions has a handler, including the destructive Remove

name: c-card-16
title: Card with header badge and actions
label: Badge & Actions
description: Card with header badge and actions

guidance.bestFor: An integration tile: a Live strip with a dots menu, an Installed badge, 3 avatars plus a count, and a full width Open button
agentNotes: `AvatarGroupCount` shows a fixed +3 beside 3 sample avatars; compute the count from your member list
The Edit and Copy link `DropdownMenuItem` entries and the Open `Button` have no handlers yet

name: c-card-17
title: Card with icon, title and link
label: Icon & Link
description: Card with icon, title and link

guidance.bestFor: A solid primary icon tile above a linked title, a muted summary and a small View link with a chevron
agentNotes: Replace the `item` constant with your own copy and icon, and point both `href` placeholders at real routes

whenNotToUse.when: A pointer whose small icon and label sit in a ruled top strip

name: c-card-18
title: Card with header label and link
label: Label & Link
description: Card with header label and link

guidance.bestFor: A muted icon and label in a bordered top strip, then a summary and a small link with a leading chain icon
agentNotes: Swap `item` for your label, summary, link text and icon, and give the anchor a real `href`

whenNotToUse.when: A bold filled icon tile leading straight into a linked title
